description: Physical shader-slot ceiling shared by both backends. TS PHYSICAL_SLOT_LIMIT (slotOrchestrator.ts) reads maxPhysicalSlots from this file; C++ MAX_SHADER_SLOTS (renderer.h) must equal it. Share URLs and App.tsx hydrate this many slots; the performance-tier quality cap (maxActiveSlots, 1-3) is a separate, lower soft limit. A slot index at or past maxPhysicalSlots is a logged no-op on both backends, never a silent drop. Enforced by verify:device-policy.
note: Committed public/wasm artifacts built before this contract are 3-slot. The TS bridge reads each slot back after setSlotShader and warns when the artifact dropped it, so a stale build is visible rather than silent. GPU-PENDING: rebuild with emcc 6.0.9.
